title: Billing thresholds and usage-bundle cutover coordination
creator: Claire Zhao
description:
Objective: Coordinate the cutover from legacy per-token SKUs to new usage-bundles with tiered billing thresholds and automated throttle/overage behavior. This ticket captures cross-functional sequencing (Billing, Payments, Backend, Console, Sales, Support) required to: map existing customers to new bundles, ensure billing pipeline parity, add real-time threshold alerts, and ship customer-facing comms and sales enablement materials.

Scope: mapping rules for grandfathered customers, migration helper scripts, billing report changes, console UI badge/limit indicators, CS playbook for overage disputes, retention of audit logs for cutover window, and test plan for production billing dry-runs.

Out of scope: wholesale price rework, SKUs unrelated to usage bundles (those are handled in sibling tickets).

Success metrics: zero silent-billing incidents in first 14 days; <2% of migrated accounts require manual reconciliation; billing latency variance within 5% of baseline after cutover.
acceptance_criteria: All customers have deterministic mapping to either a new usage-bundle or an explicit legacy grace policy
Billing pipeline published to stakeholders with signed-off parity tests and signed acceptance by Finance
Console reflects per-account threshold and current usage; badge shown for accounts within 10% of threshold
Support playbook and canned responses published; at least two support engineers trained and validated in runbook scenarios
Dry-run reconciliation executed on staging and production replicas with reconciliation delta < 1%

rollout_plan_summary: Phased cutover: 1) Internal dry-run on production replica (2025-02-14), 2) Canary group (10% of low-risk accounts) with live telemetry and CS on standby (2025-02-17), 3) Tiered ramp to remaining customers over one week with automated reconciliation scripts, 4) Final sweep and manual reconciliation for bespoke accounts. Contingency: rollback toggle to route traffic back to legacy SKU resolver and emit incident postmortem if silent-billing > 0.5%.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Silent-billing due to mapping mismatch -> Mitigation: run dry-run and parity test with finance + ledger diff alerts
Risk: Spike in support tickets -> Mitigation: dedicated support channel, pre-authored responses, and 24-hour escalation rota
Risk: Billing latency increase -> Mitigation: telemetry + canary at 10% traffic and auto-throttle to prevent downstream overload
Risk: Legal/regulatory objections in EU accounts -> Mitigation: exclude EU customers from auto-cutover until legal sign-off and perform manual outreach
qa_test_plan: Integration test: billing pipeline parity with shadow invoices for 1000 synthetic accounts
End-to-end dry-run on production replica with ledger diffs and rollback verification
